tieu_de: Brief biography of Yuan Lieu Pham
noi_dung:
BRIEF BIOGRAPHY OF YUAN LIEU
PHAM

Yuan Lieu Pham was born in 1533, formerly named Vien Bieu, later changed to Vien Hoang, given the name Khon Nghi, also had the self-name Khanh Vien; First he took the name Hoc Hai, then changed his name to Lieu Pham.

The ancestors of the Yuan family, who lived in Jiaxing prefecture, Zhejiang province, were an extremely wealthy family at the end of the Yuan Dynasty. At the beginning of the Ming Dynasty, Yen King Chu Le usurped the throne from his nephew Chu Doan Van, proclaimed himself emperor, and proclaimed himself Minh Thanh To. At that time, some people protested and were captured and killed by Minh Thanh To. The Vien family's ancestors were also hunted down because they interacted with opponents. They were lucky enough to escape, so they had to wander everywhere, then came to live in Nam Truc, in Wujiang district, Suzhou prefecture, Jiangsu province.

During Yuan Lieu Fan's reign, he married a wife from Gia Thien district and then lived with his wife, but it turned out that he returned to his ancestral hometown, Gia Hung district, Zhejiang province.

Student Vien Lieu Pham paid great attention to the practice of meditation for health care. He left behind two famous works on this topic: Nhiep Sinh Tam Suc and Tinh Tu Tu Quyet. The book Essentials of Still sitting has 3 sections: Practicing, Practicing, and Regulating. Thien Du Hanh introduces the essentials of people practicing meditation, focusing on mind control, the system of attracting the mind, training the mind, calming the mind, nourishing the mind, and training the spirit. Thien Tu Vien discusses the self-experience of zazen. Thien Dieu Tien introduces 3 methods of controlling anger in Buddhism.

He wrote the book Liu Pham's Four Instructions around 1601 (69 years old). Initially, these were just teachings he wrote down for his son, Vien Thien Khai, who was just 20 years old at that time, so he called them Gioi tu van (Essay on teaching children). Later, the book was widely circulated everywhere, so later generations changed its name to Lieu Pham Tu Huan (Four Advices of Mr. Lieu Pham).

His father died early, and his mother advised him to study as a physician. Later, he met Mr. Confucius from Yunnan who taught him the Royal Number calculation of Thieu Khang Tiet and predicted his life's destiny for him. He listened to the Confucian family's advice and quit his medical profession and studied hard to gain fame and career. In the third year of Long Khanh (1569), he met Zen Master Van Coc at The Ha mountain, Kim Lang. The Zen master taught him the principle of doing good and accumulating virtue that can change one's destiny. He was like someone who suddenly woke up from a deep sleep. From then on, he changed his name from Hoc Hai to Lieu Pham to remember this meeting and the theory of self-reliance that he had just learned. From then on, he voluntarily decided not to fall into the ordinary way of thinking and doing things of ordinary people.

In the fourth year of Long Khanh (1570), he passed the bachelor's exam. In the 14th year of Van Lich (1586), he passed his doctorate, was appointed district commander of Bao De district, and later promoted to the position of Chief of Staff at Chuc Phuong Department of the Ministry of Infantry. He participated in the war with the Japanese army in Korea, and commanded to repel the Japanese army.

In the 21st year of Wan Li (1593), on January 27, also in the war with the Japanese army that occurred in Korea, Ly Nhu Tung led the army at Bach De Quan and suffered a big defeat. The Minister of War at that time, Thach Tinh, advocated peace. Vien Lieu Pham agreed with Minister Thach

Tinh's criticism of Ly Nhu Tung's military leadership. Therefore, Tung harbored resentment.

Some time later, Ly Nhu Tung complained to the court, charging Vien Lieu Pham with 10 crimes. Because of that, Lieu Pham was dismissed and returned to his hometown.

He died in his hometown in 1606. It was not until the third year of Thien Khai (1623) that his unjust case was clarified. He was posthumously awarded military merit by the Minister of Justice, Trieu Nam Tinh, and the court posthumously awarded him the title Thuong Bao Ty Thieu Khanh.

tieu_de: THE STORY OF TRAVEL IN Y MEETING THE KITCHEN SPIRIT (TRIP TIMING Y CONG ENGLISHING TAO THAN KY)
noi_dung:
THE STORY OF JOURNEY TO THE SPIRIT
KITCHEN (TRIP TIMING Y GONG NGUYEN TAO
Spirit)

HEALTHY MEETING DATA?

During the Gia Tinh era of the Ming Dynasty,1 there was a man with the surname Du in Jiangxi province, whose last name was Do, whose given name was Luong Than,2 who was knowledgeable and had many talents. From the age of 18, he passed the baccalaureate exam, each time passing the exams with high rankings.

NOTE 1

The Gia Tinh era (嘉靖) was the reign of Minh The Tong, lasting 45 years, from 1522 to 1566.

NOTE 2

According to the details mentioned in the following section, he was born in 1525 and died in 1612. He considered himself highly talented and would definitely become a pillar of the court in the future, so he took the title Luong Than.

During his youth, his family was poor, so Du Do opened a class to accept students, and together with his fellow students, about ten people, formed the Van Xuong Xa group, [encouraging each other] to practice things such as preserving respect for [paper with] writing, releasing animals to save animals, preventing lust, killing, lying...3 Practicing like that for many years. Before and after, he participated in 7 Huong examinations but did not pass [for bachelor's degree].

NOTE 3

The group of participants in Van Xuong Xa took the practice of Wenchang Dejun's teachings in the lesson "The Sound of Literature" as their goal, so they took the name Van Xuong Xa.

Mr. Du Do gave birth to 5 sons. 4

the sick child died early. The third child is very smart and handsome, has 2 moles on the bottom of his left foot, which he and his wife love very much. When he was 8 years old, the boy went out to play in the village and suddenly got lost and did not know where to go. He gave birth to four daughters, but only one remains. His wife mourned for her child so much that she lost both eyes.

Mr. Du Do worked hard all year round but became more and more poor. He often considered himself to have committed no major crimes, not knowing why he was punished by heaven so harshly and tragically.

Since Mr. Du Do was over 40 years old, every year until the end of December, he personally wrote a note on yellow paper [lamenting about his family situation], pleading with the Kitchen God to convey it to the [Jade Emperor]. It's been so many years but I haven't seen any results.

tieu_de: The Kitchen God teaches
noi_dung:
The Kitchen God teaches

Until the age of 47, on New Year's Eve at the end of the year, Mr. Du Do was sitting in the house with his daughter and blind wife. Suddenly he heard a knock on the door, so he took a torch and went out to see. He saw a person wearing black clothes, a monk-style square turban, and beard and hair who seemed to be about five or sixty years old. That person clasped his hands and bowed politely, then [followed

into the house] sat down, introduced himself as a member of the Truong family, came from afar, heard that his family was having a sad time, so he specially came to comfort him.

Mr. Du Do saw that the guest seemed strange, so he bowed very respectfully. While chatting, he immediately told the guest surnamed Truong about how he had spent his whole life reading books of saints and sages, doing good deeds and accumulating virtue, but up to now his career path was not as expected, his wife and children were not perfect, food and clothing were not enough, and he had written petitions many times to ask the Kitchen God to present it to the [Jade Emperor] but did not see any results.

The guest surnamed Truong said: "I have known about your family for a long time. Your evil intentions are too heavy. You only know how to chase after vanity. The note you wrote is full of resentment and contempt for God. I'm afraid that the punishment has not stopped at the current level."

Mr. Du Do was extremely frightened and said: "I heard that in a dark place, even one Even small good deeds have been recorded. I have vowed to do good deeds and respectfully follow the rules [set by Van Xuong Commune] for a long time. Is it possible that all of these things are just vanity?" with whom they interact, most of them use paper from old books to tape windows, wrap things, and even use it for

clean the dust from the tables and chairs, but always say don't dirty the paper, just burn it all. He saw such things every day but there was no warning or warning. He only occasionally saw a few pieces of paper in the middle of the road and picked them up and burned them. Is that any good?

"Every time there is a mistake in his words, he uses clever and skillful eloquence, causing the listener to go crazy thinking bad is good [and admiring him]. When he opens his mouth, he still knows in his heart that he is hurting good virtue. Just because he is used to old habits, while chatting with friends, he continues to criticize and mock [others], unable to stop. His tongue like that makes the devils and gods angry; his actions make him angry. The evil and evil in the underworld have been recorded too much to tell. Yet you still consider yourself to be a deeply virtuous person, and yet you think that you have not deceived or disrespected anyone? Isn't that disrespecting the heavens?

“As for adultery, even though there was no actual act, he kept looking at the beautiful girl

carefully, my mind is no longer in control, I just don't have the right opportunity to do it. Please examine yourself in those times, can you be like Lo Nam Tu1? Yet, to dare to say that “all my life I will not be involved in any trouble fornication and lust, I can face the heavens and earth, demons and gods” [like Lu Nanzi in the past], it is a lie.

NOTE 1

Lu Nanzi: the character mentioned in the book Confucius Gia Ngu, is a native of the state of Lu, praised as "life-long" Not entangled in sexual immorality, can face the demons and gods of heaven and earth." Near Lo Nam Tu's house, there was a woman who lived alone. One day, with heavy rain and wind, her house collapsed in the middle of the night. She ran over to sleep, but Lo Nam son closed the door and wouldn't let her in. The woman saw him trying to avoid being close to men and women late at night, so she went to the window and said: "Why don't you do like Lieu Ha Hue?" The young man replied: "You and I are both young, so Lieu Ha Hue can, but I can't. I'm still learning to follow Lieu Ha Hue's what I can't."

“Those are the rules that he himself voluntarily followed, [written into the rules and regulations of Van Xuong Commune], but still like that, let alone other things?

“For many years he continuously burned notes to present to God, telling the story. God ordered the messenger Nhat Du to carefully examine his good and evil deeds. After many years, he did not see any good deeds that could be recorded. He only saw that when he was alone in a secluded and secluded place, all the thoughts of greed, lust, jealousy, narrow-mindedness, impatience, complacency and contempt for others, remembering the past, hoping for the future, revenge... arose in his heart, [so many that] it was impossible to write them all down. All kinds of evil things that arise from such thoughts have been accumulated for a long time, the gods have recorded many, and God's punishments are becoming more and more severe. Even if you want to avoid disasters, if you can't, how can you rely on them to enjoy blessings?

Mr. Du Do [heard this] was extremely horrified, extremely scared, knelt down on the ground, crying and said: "You clearly know all the things in the dark realm, you must have a relationship with the god, I beg you to save me."

The guest surnamed Truong immediately said: "You are a person who reads books, understands good manners, and also knows how to admire good things, take that as his duty." happy, but when I hear [others say] a good word, I can't encourage it. When I see [another person do] a good deed, I can't encourage it. I only [commit to] mistakes and empty things. [It's all because] the roots of my faith have not yet been deeply established. My disposition has long been accustomed to it, so I never examine myself. Therefore, throughout my life, every time I say a good word or do a good deed, [it's] just an illusory show-off, unprecedented. None of the words or actions are true. Moreover, evil thoughts are filled up in the heart, continuously arising one after another, so wishing for good blessings from heaven is like having a land full of thorns and thorns, but foolishly hoping to harvest good rice, isn't that very wrong?

“From now on, whenever you have false thoughts such as greed, lust, deceit... you must use all your strong determination to eliminate them all, purify [your mind so that it is] always pure and peaceful, each thought is only pure goodness. When you encounter a good deed, if you see that you can do it with all your strength, you must use all your strength to do it immediately, without expecting any consequences in your heart. answer, don't seek fame, no matter how big or small, difficult or easy [good deed] it is, do it with a sincere heart of love and patience; if you find that your strength cannot do it, you must wholeheartedly pay attention to it, be attentive and insistent, so that that good heart is fully nourished.

“The first essential thing is to have a patient mind, the second is to have an unrelenting mind, it is necessary not to be lazy, it is necessary to Be sincere and not deceive yourself. If you practice like this for a long time, you will naturally have unpredictable and miraculous effects.

“I see that your family has been worshiping me very sincerely for a long time, so I specially came here to say a few words, as a way to repay you. You must do it quickly without delay, with a good chance that God's will can be changed.”

The guest surnamed Truong finished speaking and went straight into the house. Du Du immediately stood up and followed. As soon as he reached the altar of the Kitchen God, he suddenly disappeared and realized that the person he had just met was him. He respectfully burned incense and bowed.

NOTE 1

The original text uses Tu Menh Chi Than (司命之神), which is another name for the Kitchen God (Tao Quan), fully called Dong Tru Tu Menh Cuu Linh Nguyen Vuong Dinh Phuoc Than Quan.

tieu_de: Rename Tinh Y, change your mind to purity
noi_dung:
CHANGE THE NAME OF TINH THANH, CHANGE THE PURE INTENT

The next day was the Lunar New Year, Mr. Du Do bowed to heaven and earth, vowing to correct all previous mistakes, practice all good deeds, and change his name. I am a Pure Intention Taoist, expressing my wish to eliminate all wrongdoing and purify my mind.

On the first day of starting to do good, mixed thoughts will arise. If you do not give rise to doubt, you will fall into laziness. After a few days like that, I found myself falling into the same confusion as before. In the house where there is a statue of Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, Du Tinh Y immediately bowed in front of the Bodhisattva statue to repent, bowed his head until his forehead bled, and respectfully made a great vow: “I vow to keep my mind pure with only good thoughts, diligently try hard to do good, if I have the slightest bit of lethargy and discouragement, vow that I will forever fall into this trap. hell.”

Every day, early in the morning, he persistently recited the name Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara Great Compassion to ask for blessings for himself [in doing good deeds]. After that, every word, every deed, every thought throughout that day, it was as if there was a demon or spirit nearby watching, absolutely not daring to lie, deceive, or indulge in indulgence.

Everything that can help other

others, can benefit others, for life, no matter how big or small it is, no matter whether you are busy or leisurely. Regardless of whether others know about it or not, without hesitating to consider whether or not he can do it himself, Du Tinh Y happily tries his best until he achieves it.

He again, depending on the conditions and expedients, generously did things to accumulate positive virtue. Furthermore, he also tried to advise people to follow moral ethics, diligently read books and learn, maintain humility, patience and respect, and often used the principles of cause and effect to preach widely to everyone. He tried diligently to do good all day long but still did not consider it enough.

On each last day of the month, Mr. Du Tinh Y would write down all the words and deeds during that month in a note and burn it in front of the altar of the Kitchen God to pay homage.

He practiced like this until he became proficient, then [reached the point where] as soon as the body moves, there will be countless good things following it, and as soon as the mind becomes calm, not a single stray thought will arise. start.

tieu_de: Turn misfortune into blessing
noi_dung:
CONVERTING HAPPINESS INTO HAPPINESS

After three years like that, he just turned 50 years old. In the second year of Van Lich, the court opened the Hoi exam

in the year Giap Tuat.1 The assistant official2 was Truong Giang Lang.3 after finishing the exam, he immediately asked his compatriots to find someone to be his child's teacher. Someone recommended Du Tinh Y, the Prime Minister immediately invited him to the capital to be a teacher for his children.

NOTE 1

That is in 1574.

NOTE 2

The highest official, head of the court during the Ming Dynasty, equivalent to the position of Prime Minister. The Chief Mandarin is the person who replaces the king to handle court affairs and direct all actions of the court.

NOTE 3

Truong Giang Lang (張江陵): real name is Truong Cu Chinh (張居正), personal name is Thuc Dai (叔大), nickname Thai Nhac (太岳). Because he was from Giang Lang, people at that time often called him Truong Giang Lang. He was born in 1525, died in 1582, and held the position of Patriarch for 10 years, from 1572 to 1582.

When he heard Du Tinh Y tell about what he had done, the Patriarch greatly respected his virtue and virtue, and immediately followed the regulations to help him enter the Quoc Hoc School.4

NOTE 4

The ancient National School was a type of University, training talented people, but only giving priority to children of the royal family and royal officials. Therefore, it was a privilege for Mr. Du Tinh Y to attend this school.

In the fourth Van Lich year, that is, the year of the Rat (1576), he took the Perfume exam in the capital, passed the bachelor's degree, and passed the doctorate the next year.

One ​​day, he came to meet the Internal Affairs Officer5 surnamed Duong, who called his five adopted children out to greet them. These sons were adopted by the Duong family from all over, considered as their own children and took joy in their old age. Du Tinh Y suddenly saw

NOTE 5

Inner guard: another name for eunuchs, serving in the inner palace.

among them was a boy about 16 years old, whose appearance seemed very familiar, so he immediately asked where he was from. The child replied: "A person from Jiangxi province,1 when he was young, he went out to play on the wrong rice boat [so he couldn't return home], but his family name at that time and the name of the village he only remembers in his mind."

NOTE 1

Originally written Giang You (江右), is another name for Jiangxi.

Du Tinh Y heard this and was extremely suspicious. He immediately told him to take off his shoes to look at the sole of his left foot. Sure enough, there were two very clear moles. He was so happy that he shouted loudly: "Oh! My child is here."

The Duong family official was also very surprised and immediately let the child follow Du Tinh Y to his residence. He hurriedly told his wife the good news. His wife was so happy, she hugged her child and cried so loudly that blood flowed from her eyes. The child also cried, then cradled his mother's face and stuck out his tongue to lick the blood from her eyes. Unexpectedly, at that moment, her eyes suddenly brightened and she could see clearly. Du Tinh Y was both happy and sad. He no longer wanted to be an official, so he said goodbye to Truong Giang Lang and returned to his hometown.

Mandarin Truong Giang Lang appreciated

Du Tinh Y's kindness, sent many gifts and

a large amount of money, and sent him off to his hometown.

Back home, he even more Try to do more good deeds. His son later got married and had 7 children, all of whom studied well and became famous.

Du Tinh Y recorded the incident of meeting the Kitchen God as well as the process of repentance and correction, used to teach and educate her children in the future.

He lived peacefully and healthily into old age, reaching the age of 88. Everyone in the world believes that it was because he sincerely did many good deeds, converting the retribution into good things.

The post-graduate who lived in the same village

with Mr. Du Tinh Y

was La Trinh who recorded this story.

tieu_de: Speech – Essentials of Dharma practice
noi_dung:
Introduction In the Dhammapada Sutra, the Buddha taught that: “Dharma

gift trumps all giving.” Practicing Dharma giving means sharing and spreading Buddha's teachings to everyone. Every Buddhist can, depending on their ability, practice Dharma giving in the following ways:

1. Try to learn, understand and practice the Buddha's teachings. The deeper you learn and understand, the more effective sharing and giving Dharma will be. Remember that reading books is more important than buying books.

2. You must cherish the scriptures and books printed with Buddha's teachings. When you have the means, buy them and bring them home so that you and your family can learn and follow them. You should not keep it as your own, but be willing to share it, spread it widely, and encourage many others to read and learn. You should not let the scriptures lie still and collect dust on the bookshelf, because if the scriptures are not read by people, they cannot bring benefits.

3. Depending on your ability, contribute material and effort to support those who do the work of compiling, translating, printing, and circulating scriptures, so that more and more precious scriptures can be printed and circulated.

Normally, spending a small amount of money cannot bring great benefits, but if used to help circulate If you practice the scriptures, the benefits will be unimaginably great. That's because it has helped many people understand and follow Buddha's teachings. I hope that Buddhists everywhere will pay attention to contribute their efforts to the above works.

ESSENTIALS OF PRACTICE OF Dharma Simulation

- Buy some scriptures to read, yourself will benefit a lot.

class="book-paragraph">- Sharing and spreading by lending and giving the scriptures to many people will increase the benefits many times over.

- Contributing effort and resources to support support the work of compiling, translating, explaining, printing, circulating scriptures the great merit cannot be measured, because countless people will benefit from the circulation of scriptures.
